functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_active(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = _user_id AND status = 'Đang hoạt động'
  );
$function$
functions.name: is_active

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_super_admin(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT private.is_active(_user_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_roles WHERE user_id=_user_id AND role_id='role-super-admin'); $function$
functions.name: is_super_admin

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.design_can(_uid uuid, _flow text, _action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
 SELECT private.is_active(_uid) AND (private.is_admin(_uid) OR CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['photo','marketing_design','order_mockup']) f WHERE private.has_permission(_uid,'order.'||f||'.'||_action)) THEN _flow IS NOT NULL AND private.has_permission(_uid,'order.'||_flow||'.'||_action) ELSE private.has_permission(_uid,'order.'||_action) END);
$function$
functions.name: design_can

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.design_read(_uid uuid, _creator uuid, _data jsonb, _flow text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
 SELECT private.is_active(_uid) AND (private.is_admin(_uid) OR (public.design_can(_uid,_flow,'view') AND (public.design_can(_uid,_flow,'view_all') OR public.design_can(_uid,_flow,'assign') OR _creator=_uid OR private.design_person(_uid,_data->>'requester') OR private.design_person(_uid,_data->>'assignee') OR private.design_person(_uid,coalesce(nullif(_data->>'reviewer',''),_data->>'requester')) OR (coalesce(_data->>'assignee','')='' AND _data->>'status' IN ('Chờ phân công','Mới tạo') AND public.design_can(_uid,_flow,'take')))));
$function$
functions.name: design_read

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cw_uid(_name text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 1 THEN (array_agg(id))[1] END FROM public.profiles
  WHERE coalesce(trim(_name),'') <> '' AND (lower(trim(full_name)) = lower(trim(_name)) OR lower(trim(username)) = lower(trim(_name)))
    AND status = 'Đang hoạt động';
$function$
functions.name: cw_uid

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_permission(_user_id uuid, _permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT private.is_active(_user_id) AND (private.is_super_admin(_user_id) OR CASE
 WHEN (private.org_role_permission_ready(_permission) OR private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(_permission) OR _permission LIKE 'sale_work.%') AND private.base_tier1(_user_id,_permission)='DENY' THEN false
 WHEN (private.org_role_permission_ready(_permission) OR private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(_permission) OR _permission LIKE 'sale_work.%') AND private.base_tier1(_user_id,_permission)='ALLOW' THEN true
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND o.mode='replace') THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND _permission=ANY(o.permissions))
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN app_roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=_user_id AND _permission=ANY(r.permissions))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND o.mode='additive' AND _permission=ANY(o.permissions)) END) $function$
functions.name: has_permission
